Together, our 120,000 caregivers (all employees) serve in over 50 hospitals, over 1,000 clinics and a full range of health and social services across Alaska, California, Montana, New Mexico, Oregon, Texas and Washington. As a comprehensive health care organization, we are serving more people, advancing best practices and continuing our more than 100-year tradition of serving the poor and vulnerable.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Data Analyst

Role Overview

Reporting directly to the Director, Data Analytics,
the Data Analyst contributes to the front-end reporting experience for Corporate Metrics, including Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR). This role owns the Databricks Apps code bases that deliver Corporate Metrics to business users, combining analytical and business expertise with the technical depth to build, ship, and support reporting applications. Operating as a bridge between business and technical teams, the role turns trusted data into reporting used for strategic decision-making.
Location: United States
Work Arrangement: Remote
Employment Type: Full time

Key Responsibilities

Develop, enhance, test, and maintain assigned Corporate Metrics Databricks Apps, including ARR, using AI-assisted development tools and established standards to ensure accuracy, performance, security, and usability.
Design front-end reporting layouts, filters, drill-downs, and KPI presentations that clarify business questions and improve visibility into metrics and forecasting.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to document business processes, reporting requirements, and data sources, translating them into application features and data requirements.
Partner with Analytics leads and Central Data Engineering on dimensional models and semantic layers, recommending data warehouse schema changes to support front-end reporting needs.
Define and document metric calculations and validate application outputs against source data and published figures to maintain reporting accuracy.
Manage application releases through source control, code reviews, and testing in compliance with SOX and internal governance processes.
Facilitate user enablement through training, feedback collection, usage tracking, and prioritizing continuous reporting enhancements and automations.
Collaborate with cross-functional metrics, intelligence, governance, and technology teams, mentor junior colleagues, and contribute to team development standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or reporting, ideally including exposure to corporate, financial, or revenue reporting.
Experience building and maintaining reporting applications or dashboards, ideally Databricks Apps or similar code-based tools such as Streamlit, Dash, or React.
Working proficiency in Python and strong SQL skills for querying, analyzing, and validating large datasets.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to build and maintain production code.
Familiarity with dimensional data models and semantic layers as a consumer and design partner, as well as source control and DevOps processes using tools such as GitHub or Azure DevOps.
Understanding of ARR and other SaaS and corporate metrics, experience in process mapping and requirements documentation, and excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

Bonus Skills

Experience with Databricks AI/BI features such as Genie, Metric Views, or AI/BI Dashboards.
Experience with UX or data visualization design principles.
Knowledge of sales tools and technology, including CRM and Quote to Cash (QTC) systems, particularly Salesforce.
Experience with automated testing for applications or data.
Experience with external Corporate reporting needs for a public company.

Compensation & Benefits

The compensation range reflects expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. Compensation is determined by factors including experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range.

U.S. Geographic Zones & Compensation Ranges (TTC / OTE):
Zone 1 (San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Boroughs): $137,160—$228,480 USD
Zone 2 (Washington, California excluding San Francisco Bay Area): $125,730—$209,440 USD
Zone 3 (Texas, Illinois, North Carolina, Colorado, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Oregon, Nevada, Hawaii, New York excluding NYC boroughs; Sales roles located in Georgia, Ohio, and Arizona): $114,300—$190,400 USD
Zone 4 (All other US locations): $99,441—$165,648 USD

Comprehensive benefits include:
Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on the first day
Paid time off, paid holidays, and paid volunteer time
Paid parental leave
Mental health support, therapy sessions, and employee assistance program tools
401(k) retirement plan with company match
Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support, along with virtual veterinary care
Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
Learning and professional development opportunities, including workshops, mentoring, and on-demand learning libraries

Equal Opportunity Notice

The hiring organization is an equal opportunity employer and does not tolerate discrimination in any form on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by federal, state or local law. All information will be kept confidential.

jobs.title: Medical Lab Technician 2
jobs.description:
Job Description

Medical Laboratory Technician 2

We are looking for dedicated Medical Laboratory Technician 2 in the Fairfax area
. These roles will be full-time, day shift with varying hours from 7:30 a.m. – 5:30 p.m. Monday – Friday.

Inova is consistently ranked a national healthcare leader in safety, quality and patient experience. We are also proud to be consistently recognized as a top employer in both the D.C. metro area and the nation.

Featured Benefits

Committed to Team Member Health: offering medical, dental and vision coverage, and a robust team member wellness program.
Retirement: Inova matches the first 5% of eligible contributions – starting on your first day.
Tuition and Student Loan Assistance: offering up to $5,250 per year in education assistance and up to $10,000 for student loans.
Mental Health Support: offering all Inova team members, their spouses/partners, and their children 25 mental health coaching or therapy sessions, per person, per year, at no cost.
Work/Life Balance: offering paid time off and paid parental leave.

Medical Laboratory Technician 2 Job Responsibilities

Medical Laboratory Technician 2 ensures quality specimens for Laboratory testing by recognizing pre-analytical factors that adversely affect patient results.
Communicate effectively and work cooperatively with team members to optimize job performance and foster working relationships.
Demonstrating a knowledge of operational/regulatory standards.
Operates systems/methodologies in order to produce timely and accurate data for patients, quality control and proficiency testing.
Participates in professional growth opportunities to enhance personal, team and departmental development by demonstrating operational knowledge and adhering to regulatory standards.

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Associate’s degree in science from a college/university recognized by regional or national accreditation agency. Other acceptable forms of education will follow the guidelines of American Society for Clinical Pathology or American Medical Technologists Board certification. For TA + Onboarding: FORMS OF ACCEPTABLE EDU: Associate's degree or 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) of academic credit from a regionally accredited college/university with 6 semester hours (9 quarter hours) in chemistry and 6 semester hours (9 quarter hours) in biology with the ELIGIBILITY for ASCP Board certification And one of the following:
Successful completion of a National Accrediting Agency for Clinical Laboratory Science or Accredited Bureau of Health Education Schools accredited Medical Lab Technician program. Successful completion of a 50-week U.S. military medical laboratory training course within the last ten years. Or three years of full-time acceptable clinical experience for eligibility for Medical Lab Technician. ***Board certification ELIGIBILITY can be used as proof that this requirement is met**
Experience: 1 year of experience Successful completion National Accrediting Agency for Clinical Laboratory Science or Accredited Bureau of Health Education Schools accredited Medical Lab Technician program., or a foreign medical laboratory science clinical training program within the 12 months can be used in lieu of 1 year of full time acceptable clinical experience.
Certification: Certified Medical Lab Technician or Medical Laboratory Technician-Upon start.

About Us

We are Inova, Northern Virginia’s leading nonprofit healthcare provider. Every day, our 26,000+ team members provide world-class healthcare to the communities we serve. Our people are the reason we're a national leader in healthcare safety, quality and patient experience. And from best-in-class facilities to professional development opportunities, we support them at every step. At Inova, we're constantly striving to be ever better — to shape a more compassionate future for healthcare.

Inova Health is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, national or ethnic origin, political affiliation, pregnancy (including childbirth, pregnancy-related conditions and lactation), race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristics protected by law.
